Markdown: 'Channel combination to analyze, from the channel combos listed above' (the unique channel_combo values in the cluster combo TSV). Selects which clustering result is plotted and handed to mozzarellm, so it must be one of the combos the cluster phase actually produced.

Markdown: 'Cell class to analyze, from the cell classes listed above' (the unique cell_class values in the cluster combo TSV — 'all' unless classify split the data). Part of the same three-part selection of the clustering result to analyze.

Markdown: 'Leiden resolution to analyze, ideally the optimal resolution reported above.' The resolution search cell above prints the optimal resolution per cell class / channel combo under RESOLUTION_METRIC; the operator confirms or overrides it after looking at the comparison plot.

e.g., "nucleus"  ||  Markdown: 'Compartment combo to analyze, ex "nucleus". Only used when aggregate.split_by_compartment is on; leave None otherwise.' One of the combos COMPARTMENT_COMBOS produced, completing the selection of the clustering result that is plotted and handed to mozzarellm.

e.g., "claude-sonnet-5", "gpt-5", "gemini-2.5-pro"  ||  Markdown: 'LLM model identifier passed to mozzarellm. The API key for the corresponding provider must be present in .env.' The lab-standard model; override only to compare providers, and only with a key for that provider in .env.

"standard" | "cot" | "stepwise"  ||  Markdown: 'Prompting mode. "cot" reasons through the cluster in one call, "standard" is a single flat prompt, "stepwise" spends one API call per reasoning step.' Chain-of-thought is the lab standard: it is the mode that also accepts the phenotypic features, at one call per cluster.

Markdown: 'Give the model PubMed search tools so genes left unannotated are filled in from retrieved literature. On by default, with "cot", as mozzarellm's benchmark-selected configuration; it costs several extra API turns per cluster.' On by default: this is the configuration mozzarellm's benchmark selected, and it combines with the phenotypic features.

Annotation source. The lab default is affinage_then_uniprot: use Affinage with UniProt fallback. Other supported choices are affinage, uniprot, and both. Preserve an existing operator choice; do not replace it when defaults change.

Markdown: 'Put each gene's phenotypic features into the bundle so the pathway call has to be consistent with the observed morphology. "auto" lets mozzarellm include them whenever the bundles carry them; True requires them and False strips them.' The lab leaves it on "auto" so mozzarellm decides from the bundles it was handed; True errors when the features are absent.

Markdown: 'Put each gene's perturbation strength rank into the bundle so the model can weigh how strongly a gene moves the phenotype. Same "auto" / True / False contract as the features.' The strength column is perturbation_auc from the cluster h5ad; "auto" includes it whenever the bundles carry it.
Number of up and down features kept per gene when building the cluster table. The lab default is twenty per direction, matching the analysis notebook. Preserve existing operator choices.

Markdown: 'FDR cutoff a feature must pass to be listed for a gene. None keeps the strongest features regardless of significance.' Left unset by the lab so every gene contributes its strongest features; set it to list only features that clear the cutoff.

Markdown: 'Maximum tokens per model response. 64000 is the ceiling a feature-augmented run needs; lower it only to cap spend.' 64000 rather than mozzarellm's own 32000 client default, which truncates a feature-augmented cot response.

Markdown: 'Annotate the clustering selected above (CHANNEL_COMBO / CELL_CLASS / LEIDEN_RESOLUTION), as one row. This is the usual case: annotate the clustering you have been looking at.' True on every screen; turn it off only when the extra clusterings below are the whole selection.

e.g., [{"channel_combo": "DAPI_WGA", "leiden_resolution": [6, 8]}]  ||  Markdown: 'Additional rows, each a dict of any of channel_combo, cell_class, leiden_resolution, compartment_combo. A key you leave out inherits the selection above, and any value may be a list, which expands as a cross product.' The genuine per-screen decision: one clustering, a handful, or the whole screen via panel_tier_clusterings(screen, config, cluster_combos, SPLIT_BY_COMPARTMENT). A resolution of "optimal" asks for the benchmark-derived pick by name, which ranks resolutions by CORUM/KEGG/STRING enrichment and so favours already-known complexes.

Markdown: 'Re-derive every screen context from screen.yaml, discarding hand edits.' Off by default because a context file belongs to the operator once it exists: it is derived once as a starting point and then hand-edited to describe the assay. Durable per-channel facts belong in screen.yaml's channel description instead.

Markdown: 'Name of the run directory each annotation writes into, under {cluster_path}/mozzarellm/. Keep it stable to resume an interrupted run; change it to annotate the same clusterings again beside the answers already there.' The rule's outputs are named from it, so a fixed name is what lets snakemake resume rather than re-annotate.

Markdown: 'Clusters one job answers concurrently, and the cores that job asks slurm for.' Eight keeps a clustering's annotation inside a few minutes without tripping the provider's rate limit; lower it if the provider starts throttling.

Markdown: 'Clusters a panel may lose before its job fails.' A failed job writes nothing, so before this key one permanently unanswerable cluster discarded a panel's other 929 answers. Two is small enough that a real outage still fails the job, and transient failures are already covered by the rule's retries plus resume.

Markdown: 'Wall time in minutes each annotation job asks slurm for.' Twelve hours: these jobs answer hundreds of clusters over hours where every other brieflow rule runs for minutes, so a profile whose default wall time suits the rest of the pipeline would kill them.
